title: Cheaply made, poorly designed.
text: Cheaply made, poorly designed.. Ugh. I'm so tired of junk and I see this exact paper towel holder being sold under several "brands". This is not truly functional in a real kitchen. It glues on the wall - recipe for failure over time. The actual bar does not hold a full roll of paper towels, the space is too narrow. It just looks cheap to me. I've relegated this to the bathroom at the horse barn. When it falls apart out there, it won't be a problem.
